lines.japanese: ――ナラやクヌギの葉越しに空が見えた。
lines.english: —Through the leaves of oaks and sawtooth oaks, I could see the sky.

lines.japanese: 天空にそびえる発光体。雲一つない空から降り注ぐその光線は、ときおり無性に見上げたくなって、僕の足元をおろそかにさせる。踏んだ小枝のパキリと折れる音がした。
lines.english: A luminous body towered in the heavens. Its rays poured from a cloudless sky, and every so often I felt an irresistible need to look up, heedless of where I put my feet. A twig snapped beneath my shoe.

lines.japanese: この辺りはけもの道とまではいかなくても、ほとんどひとの通らなくなった道がいくつかある。
lines.english: There were several paths around here which, though not quite animal trails, scarcely saw a human traveler anymore.

lines.japanese: 僕は晴れた日にそんな道を歩くのが好きだった。
lines.english: On clear days, I liked to walk them.

lines.japanese: 別に整備された歩道を使ってもいいんだけど、当たり前すぎて面白みがない。こうして突きだしてきた枝を掻きわけながら進むだけで目的地の印象も変わると思うんだ。
lines.english: I could've used the maintained path, but that felt too obvious and boring. Just pushing through the branches sticking out like this changed how the place felt when I got there.

lines.japanese: 額から一筋だけ垂れてきた汗を腕で拭う。ハンカチを持ってくればよかったとも思うけど、どうせこれだけ汗をかいたんじゃすぐに使い物にならなくなる。
lines.english: I wiped the one line of sweat running down my forehead with my arm. I kind of wished I'd brought a handkerchief, but with this much sweat it'd be useless in no time anyway.

lines.japanese: やがて一車線の道路に出た。交通量のほとんどないアスファルト上を、朱色のタクシーが一台通りすぎてゆく。
lines.english: At last I emerged onto a single-lane road. One vermilion taxi passed along the nearly deserted asphalt.

lines.japanese: 僕は遮るもののない空を見上げた。
lines.english: I looked up at the unobstructed sky.

lines.japanese: 「高いなあ」
lines.english: “It's so high.”

lines.japanese: この空は、いつか好きだった空とはちがう色だ。
lines.english: This sky was a different color from the one I had once loved.

lines.japanese: すこし柳木原が懐かしくなった。
lines.english: For a moment, I missed Yanagihara.

lines.japanese: 「ああそうだ、戻らなきゃ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. I should get back.”

lines.japanese: どうせ目的地は同じだ。舗装路を上っていったタクシーに張りあって、僕はショートカットした山路を上った。
lines.english: We were headed to the same place anyway. Determined to beat the taxi as it followed the paved road uphill, I took a shortcut up the mountain path.

lines.japanese: 青い空、緑の野、柔らかい陽光。それらに包まれたこの高原は、誰かの夢のふちみたいだ。
lines.english: Blue sky, green fields, gentle sunlight. Wrapped in them, this plateau seemed like the far edge of somebody's dream.

lines.japanese: 今日は診察の前に面会がある。
lines.english: I had a visitor before my examination today.

lines.japanese: 何日も前から楽しみにしていた僕は、どうにも落ちつかないから丘のふもとでその時間を待っていたんだ。
lines.english: I'd been looking forward to it for days and couldn't settle down, so I waited at the foot of the hill until it was time.

lines.japanese: 一服終えたらしいタクシーの運転手が、時速４０キロほどの呑気さで来た道を戻っていった。
lines.english: The taxi driver, apparently finished with his cigarette break, trundled back the way he had come at a leisurely twenty-five miles an hour.

lines.japanese: 「いらっしゃい」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: 車寄せに残っていたのは僕の恋人。
lines.english: The only person left in the drive was the girl I loved.

lines.japanese: 涼風吹きわたる高原にぴったりなサマードレスと、それを嫌みなく着こなせる素材のコラボレーションが、やたら場違いに感じられた。
lines.english: A summer dress made for this breezy plateau, and a girl who could carry it off without looking affected: somehow, the combination seemed absurdly out of place.

lines.japanese: 「なにその格好」
lines.english: “What are you wearing?”

lines.japanese: おそろしく似合ってるけど、明らかに彼女の趣味じゃない。
lines.english: It looked ridiculously good on her, but it obviously wasn't her style.

lines.japanese: 「順調？」
lines.english: “Is it going well?”

lines.japanese: 僕の質問は夏の風に遮られて届かなかったみたいだ。渡来さんはその涼風が渡ってくる方角を眺望しながら訊いた。僕は答える。
lines.english: The summer wind must have stopped my question from reaching her. Gazing toward the place the cool breeze came from, Watarai asked one of her own. I answered.

lines.japanese: 「うん、どうなんだろ。なにか変わってるとしても、自分じゃ分からないからね」
lines.english: “Yeah, I dunno. Even if something's changed, I wouldn't be able to tell myself.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ順調ってことでいいよね。よかった」
lines.english: “Then we'll say it's going well. I'm glad.”

lines.japanese: 一陣、強い風が来た。ふくらむスカートをさりげなく押さえる姿が、とてつもなく絵になる。僕は四本の指でフレームを切ろうとして、やめた。
lines.english: A strong gust swept over us. The casual way she held down her billowing skirt was impossibly picturesque. I raised four fingers to frame the image, then thought better of it.

lines.japanese: 「早く羽田君が帰ってくるといいなあ。毎日楽しみにしてる」
lines.english: “I hope you can come home soon. I look forward to it every day.”

lines.japanese: 「よくそんなことはっきりと言えるね」
lines.english: “You really can just come right out and say things like that, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「だって二人しかいないし、誰も聞いてないんだからよくない？」
lines.english: “There are only two of us, and no one can hear. Why shouldn't I?”

lines.japanese: 彼女はとても自然体で笑う。驚くくらいに整った渡来さんの表情の中でも、これだけは格別で抜群でとびっきりだ。
lines.english: Her smile was utterly unguarded. Among all Watarai's astonishingly beautiful expressions, this one stood apart. It was exceptional, incomparable, the very best of them all.

lines.japanese: きっとこの笑顔を見られるのは、僕だけなんじゃないかなって思う。そんな大それた自信がいまの僕にはあった。
lines.english: I thought I might be the only person who got to see that smile. I had that much audacity now.

lines.japanese: 風が止んだ。僕はもう一度訊いた。
lines.english: The wind died. I asked again.

lines.japanese: 「それで、その格好はなに？」
lines.english: “So, what is that outfit?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “What was that?”

lines.japanese: 睨まれた。やっぱり一度目の質問も、本当は聞こえてたんじゃないかな。僕の彼女は颯爽としてるけど、ときどき妙なところで照れ屋さんなんだ。なんちゃって。
lines.english: She glared at me. Perhaps she really had heard me the first time. My girlfriend carried herself with fearless grace, but every now and then she turned bashful over the strangest things. Just kidding.

lines.japanese: 「青い空、緑の野、柔らかな陽光、純白のサマードレスを着て麦わら帽子を押さえながら微笑む美少女」
lines.english: “Blue sky, green fields, gentle sunlight—and a beautiful girl smiling in a pure-white summer dress as she holds down her straw hat.”

lines.japanese: 「美少女。うん」
lines.english: “A beautiful girl. Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「彼氏の夢を叶えてあげたいと思うのは、女の子なら誰でも同じなんじゃないかな」
lines.english: “Every girl wants to make her boyfriend's dream come true, doesn't she?”

lines.japanese: 言葉の終わりにまた強い風が来て、彼女のスカートを捲りあげる。地面から伸びる二本の白い脚は、小説の一幕みたいに出来すぎていた。
lines.english: Another gust arrived at the end of her sentence and swept up her skirt. The two white legs rising from the earth were so perfectly composed that they might have belonged to a scene in a novel.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、その服ってわざわざ用意してくれたんだ」
lines.english: “So you went out and found that dress just for me?”

lines.japanese: 「うんまあ」
lines.english: “More or less.”

lines.japanese: 「そういう服ってどこに行けば売ってるの？」
lines.english: “Where do you even buy something like that?”

lines.japanese: 「探せばあるよ。まあ、探すのに多少……時間はかかったけど」
lines.english: “You can find one if you look. Though finding it did take... a little time.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱり部屋で試し着とかしたの？」
lines.english: “Did you try it on in your room?”

lines.japanese: 「いやもう、ね。恥ずかしいから、ホントに。許して」
lines.english: “Please, just... I'm embarrassed, honestly. Have mercy.”

lines.japanese: 「恥ずかしくなんかないけどなあ。すごくよく似合ってるよ」
lines.english: “There's nothing to be embarrassed about. It looks wonderful on you.”

lines.japanese: 「やめて、もうホント。ホントにすみません。もうなんかホント。ホントに。ホントごめんなさい」
lines.english: “Stop. Honestly, please. I'm truly sorry. This is all so... honestly. I mean it. I'm so sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 僕の言葉に恨めしく唸りながらも、彼女は麦わら帽子のつばを小さく下げることで応えた。これは照れかくし。最近ようやく分かってきた。
lines.english: She groaned resentfully at my words, but answered by dipping the brim of her straw hat. That was how she hid her embarrassment. I had finally begun to understand.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ渡来さん」
lines.english: “Listen, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 僕は言う。
lines.english: I went on.

lines.japanese: 「経過は悪くないらしいんだけど、やっぱり結構な時間が必要かもしれないんだ」
lines.english: “They say I'm making decent progress, but it may still take quite a long time.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、決して無理にとは言えないけど、僕の好きな渡来さん、もし良かったら待っててくだ──」
lines.english: “So I can’t insist. But I love you, Watarai, and if you’re willing, would you please wait for—”

lines.japanese: 「うんいいよ」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. Of course.”

lines.japanese: 「……あっさりだね」
lines.english: “...That was quick.”

lines.japanese: わりと大事なことを言ったつもりだったのに、相変わらず彼女はマイペースだ。
lines.english: I had thought I was saying something fairly momentous. But Watarai remained entirely herself.

lines.japanese: 「だって迷う余地ないもん。想像してみようよ」
lines.english: “There's nothing to think about. Just imagine it.”

lines.japanese: 「たとえば朝、私は数人の友人たちと出会い、実に分かりにくい昨日の講義について話しながら通学路を歩いてる」
lines.english: “One morning, for example, I meet a few friends and walk to campus with them while we discuss yesterday's remarkably incomprehensible lecture.”

lines.japanese: 「そこで私を見つけて小走りに近寄りつつ、羽田君は元気に声をかけてくれるんだ」
lines.english: “You spot me, trot over, and call out cheerfully.”

lines.japanese: 「『おはよう渡来さん、今日はいい天気だね』。ゼミの友達はそんなベタな挨拶にきょとんとして、驚いた表情で振りかえる」
lines.english: “‘Good morning, Watarai. Beautiful weather today.’ At that hopelessly ordinary greeting, my seminar friends turn around with startled, bewildered looks.”

lines.japanese: 「そこで私は、ワンテンポ遅れて友人と同じ向きに顔を合わせこう言うんだ」
lines.english: “One beat behind them, I turn the same way, look at you, and say—”

lines.japanese: 「『おはよう羽田君、今日はとてもいい天気ね』」
lines.english: “'Good morning, Haneda. Yes, the weather is quite beautiful today.'”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 「待て待て、最後のは笑うところじゃない」
lines.english: “Wait, wait. That last part wasn't a joke.”

lines.japanese: わりと真剣な表情だ。もしかしたら本当に冗談じゃなかったのかもしれない。
lines.english: She looked fairly serious. Perhaps it truly had not been a joke.

lines.japanese: 「想像力の豊かな人間になろうと思うんだ」
lines.english: “I've decided to become a person with a rich imagination.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君みたいにすべて前向きに想像できる人間になりたい」
lines.english: I want to be the kind of person who can imagine a way forward in everything, like you.

lines.japanese: 彼女はそう答えた。それなら大丈夫。
lines.english: That was her answer. Then everything would be all right.

lines.japanese: 僕の中のプリンセス明日香は、これから先もずっと一緒にいてくれるんだから。
lines.english: Because Princess Asuka, the one who lived inside me, would remain with me forever.

lines.japanese: 「さしあたって──」
lines.english: “For the moment—”

lines.japanese: 彼女は言葉を続けた。
lines.english: She continued.

lines.japanese: 「──とりあえずいまは、そんなずっと先のことよりも数秒後のことを想像したいな」
lines.english: —but for now, instead of imagining that far ahead, I want to imagine the next few seconds.

lines.japanese: 「うん、いま僕も、したいことをイメージしてるよ」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I'm picturing something I want to do right now too.”

lines.japanese: 「私も。もしかしたら同じこと考えてるかも」
lines.english: “So am I. We may even be thinking of the same thing.”

lines.japanese: 「待って。先に言いたい」
lines.english: “Wait. Let me say it first.”

lines.japanese: 僕はクローバーの野を進む。初夏の光が降りそそぐ中、優しくて柔らかな風がふたりを撫でていった。
lines.english: I crossed the field of clover. Beneath the falling light of early summer, a soft, gentle wind caressed us both.

lines.japanese: 「１０秒後に渡来さんとキスしてる」
lines.english: “Ten seconds from now, I'm kissing you.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなこと考えてる」
lines.english: “That's what I'm imagining.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm-hm.”

lines.japanese: そして渡来さんが笑った。
lines.english: And then Watarai smiled.

lines.japanese: 「そういう日もある」
lines.english: “Some days are like that.”
